title: AI responses are often harder to follow than they need to be.
description: “I Have ADHD” is a GitHub skill built around 10 simple rules that turn long, overwhelming AI messages into shorter, clearer answers. You do not need to have ADHD to find it useful—it makes AI much easier to read for everyone.
